scripts.e2e: cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/test_e2e_core_flow.py
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/backend && uv run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/backend && uv run celery -A worker.celery_app:celery_app worker -Q havi.default,havi.content,havi.publish,havi.video_publish -l info

scripts.migrate: cd apps/backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
